text:
Sachin: heads up — starting the staged deploy for feature/batch-rewrite now. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 45m with telemetry checks at each step. pin v2.3.1 for cohort A.
Emma: copy. which flag key are we toggling? want to make the CLI snippet explicit so ops can follow.
Sachin: flag key is feature.batch_rewrite.v2. new rollout policy: throttle to 1% for 10m, if SLOs ok shift to 5% for 10m, then 20% for 15m, then 50% with monitoring for 10m. manual hold at each gate. pinVersion: v2.3.1 for group=A; fallback: v2.2.9.
deploy-bot: Deploy request acknowledged by deploy-bot. Queue position: 3. ETA start: +2m. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/feature-batch-rewrite
Emma: cc @Ops_Jamie — can you stand by for manual unpin if latency spikes? also please confirm alerts are scoped to cohort A and not global.
Ops_Jamie: on it. I updated the alert filter to cohort=A and set thresholds: p95 latency > 420ms OR error-rate > 0.5% triggers auto-suspend and notifies oncall.
Lee: small nit — let's enable KV-prefix cache for this rollout, reduces tail latency. adding config now.
Sachin: putting the command here for transparency:
```bash
# start rollout (manual hold at each step)
deploy-bot start-rollout \
  --flag feature.batch_rewrite.v2 \
  --plan "1@10m,5@10m,20@15m,50@10m" \
  --pin cohort:A=v2.3.1 \
  --fallback v2.2.9 \
  --notes "experiment rewrite: observe p95 and ERR" 
```
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated. Step 1: set 1% traffic to v2.3.1 for cohort=A. Hold for manual approval or auto-grace. ID: rb-5991234567
Emma: confirming I see telemetry: no p95 spike yet, errors 0.02%.
Sachin: moving to 5% after 10m if metrics stay stable. leaving the manual hold window open for 2m.
Ops_Jamie: got an alert in the test slice (non-A) — looks like a misrouted traffic annotation, not related. suppressing duplicate.
Lee: cache change rolled for the cohort — patch applied and warmed.
Emma: quick note for release notes: "feature.batch_rewrite: progressive rollout of v2.3.1 with KV cache warmup; canary cohort pinned; fallback to v2.2.9." I'll draft and post in #release-notes after final verification.
Sachin: if any step breaches threshold, we auto-suspend and immediately pin all traffic back to v2.2.9. Manual rollback command below:
```bash
deploy-bot rollback --rollout-id rb-5991234567 --target-version v2.2.9 --reason "slo-breach"
```
deploy-bot: Noted. Auto-suspend policy is active. Monitoring hooks will trigger rollback if conditions met.
Emma: looks good. proceeding to step 2 (5%). I'll update the release notes draft and ping product for one-line summary.
Sachin: thanks team. keep chatter here for audit trail. :thumbsup:
